Videos published within the last 10 days (e.g., Venus day length, dark planets, and liquid diamond planets) dominate top engagement, showing strong viewer retention for surreal, visually distinct cosmic environments.

winning_patterns.action: Double down on surreal astronomical scenarios and extreme physics experiments that invoke vivid mental imagery within the first 3 seconds.

weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize straightforward biological trivia unless framed through an extreme survival or microscopic cinematic lens.
